scientific_role: paper-derived fixed-recipe cortical graph-method control and threshold sensitivity; not an original-paper cohort replication or intrinsic brain ranking
independent_observational_unit: one released participant/run; parcels, edges and threshold settings are not additional independent people

source.source_basename_pid_rule: original seven-digit zero-padded subject filename; public participant is its exact positive integer, not arbitrary digit extraction
source.source_input_stage: released preprocessed BOLD and supplied nuisance regressors; complete inherited filtering/smoothing/preprocessing history is not established
source.raw_activity_reads_before_freeze: None: only original byte identities, source headers and atlas-only geometry were inspected before this contract was frozen.
source.source_hash_authority: All40 original NITRC subject archives and the metadata archive were freshly retrieved over HTTPS; all83 selected original members exactly match the prior cached identities. Archive/member SHA256 values are locally measured reproducibility pins, not publisher checksums or an immutable upstream commitment. Atlas image/LUT/license are anchored by independently published Git blob identities at the pinned commit.
source.required_source_identity: exact closed manifest path/size/SHA256/role membership, all 40 original BOLD-confound joins, exact atlas image and LUT; no runtime fetch or source substitution
source.usage_terms: ADHD subset is described by Nilearn as noncommercial research data; public availability does not establish unrestricted redistribution or commercial permission

atlas.name: Schaefer2018 original 100 parcels, Yeo17 network ordering, FSLMNI152 2 mm
atlas.roi_ids: all integers 1 through 100 in increasing ID order
atlas.label_table_policy: preserve exact original ID/name mapping, parse all 100 labels; the first numeric ID and label string are used, color fields are not analysis variables
atlas.scope: cortical parcels, not an all-brain node set
atlas.structural_inspection_status: Original atlas91x109x91 and exact labels0..100 verified; geometry-only resampling to61x73x61 retains all100 original parcels with107..957 voxels each and no target coordinates outside the atlas closed-center domain. Full structural mapping is retained in the source manifest.

geometry.coordinate_convention: original voxel-index axes and NIfTI image affine; no canonical reorientation, crop, padding, BOLD interpolation or extra brain mask
geometry.target: each original BOLD spatial grid; all 40 source headers are expected to match the declared shared grid
geometry.nifti_numeric_scaling: apply original header scaling when loading; convert actual BOLD intensities to float64 before spatial or temporal reduction
geometry.atlas_labels: finite exact integer labels 0 through 100; verify original LUT identity and all required nonbackground labels
geometry.resampling_transform: for output BOLD index x, input atlas coordinate is inverse(atlas_affine) @ bold_affine @ [x,1]
geometry.observed_source_transform: the original source affines share translations and axis directions, so the declared transform is exactly1.5 times each BOLD voxel coordinate; odd BOLD coordinates produce exact half-integer atlas positions

resampling.half_voxel_rule: after the continuous-coordinate domain check, evaluate floor(coordinate+0.5) in float64 on each axis; exact positive half-integers round upward, not ties-to-even np.rint. The float64 addition itself is part of the rule: a representational neighbor below a half-integer can round onto the integer when0.5 is added, as in nextafter(0.5,-inf)+0.5==1.0
resampling.outside_domain: if any continuous atlas coordinate is <0 or >source_shape[axis]-1, assign background0 before rounding; the valid domain is the closed interval between first and last voxel centers, not an expanded half-voxel box and not nearest-edge extension

geometry.parcel_reduction: arithmetic mean of every voxel assigned to that original ROI ID on the target grid; float64 accumulation, with C-order voxel enumeration for reproducibility
geometry.coverage_precondition: all 100 ROI IDs have at least one target-grid voxel; no missing ROI, dropped column or substituted zero signal is allowed
geometry.resampling_relation_to_nilearn: explicit target-data nearest-neighbor adaptation; verify independently against pinned source geometry instead of asserting bitwise equivalence to all Nilearn paths

preprocessing.frame_selection: all original frames in original chronological order; no deletion, scrubbing, interpolation or temporal resampling
preprocessing.important_distinction: no additional detrend does not mean no linear trend regression: the original linearTrend confound is retained, and the released source may already have unknown inherited processing
preprocessing.confound_join: exact one supplied row per original BOLD frame, in original order; no numeric-header row or index column treated as a confound
preprocessing.finite_precondition: every selected source BOLD value, confound value and intermediate used by the recipe is finite; undefined data are not silently omitted or replaced
preprocessing.global_regressor: the supplied global column is explicitly included; this is not a no-GSR pipeline
preprocessing.constant_confound_rule: a column is exactly constant iff every original value equals its first value; record and remove only such columns before standardization
preprocessing.original_constant_signal_precondition: before centering, fail if any original parcel column has every value exactly equal to its first value; do not normalize mean-subtraction roundoff from a constant signal
preprocessing.signal_centering: subtract each parcel's arithmetic mean across all T frames
preprocessing.confound_centering: for each retained confound subtract its arithmetic mean across all T frames
preprocessing.confound_scaling: divide each centered retained column by sqrt(sum(centered_column**2)/T), the population SD; nonconstant columns with nonpositive/nonfinite computed SD fail the precondition

confound_svd.matrix_shape: T by K, where K is the count after exactly constant columns are removed
confound_svd.decomposition: thin SVD of the centered population-standardized confound matrix
confound_svd.retained_modes: strictly greater than the threshold; equality is excluded
confound_svd.empty_matrix: K=0 gives rank0, threshold0 and an empty nuisance span
confound_svd.equivalent_implementations: another stable orthogonal-span implementation is acceptable if it implements the same declared rank rule and produces source-equivalent results; SVD vector signs are not graded

preprocessing.residual_centering: subtract each residual parcel column's arithmetic mean again
preprocessing.residual_standardization: divide each re-centered residual parcel by sample SD sqrt(sum(residual**2)/(T-1))
preprocessing.constant_residual_precondition: after nuisance projection and residual re-centering, define original_L2 as the L2 norm of the original centered parcel column and residual_L2 as the L2 norm of its re-centered residual. Fail if residual_L2 <=10*max(T,K)*float64_epsilon*max(original_L2,float64_tiny), or either norm/intermediate is nonfinite or original_L2 is zero. K is the number of nonconstant confound columns before SVD rank selection; float64_tiny=2.2250738585072014e-308. This dimension-scaled roundoff guard is a numerical-zero condition, not physiological amplitude selection. Do not add epsilon, omit parcels or impute correlations
preprocessing.estimator: empirical Pearson, not Ledoit-Wolf or another shrinkage covariance
preprocessing.correlation_formula: for i<j, sum(Z[:,i]*Z[:,j])/(T-1), where Z is the standardized residual matrix; mirror this single upper-triangle value and set the diagonal to1
preprocessing.correlation_clipping: Do not clip off-diagonal connectome weights. Require finite values with abs(r)<=1+1e-12; excursions beyond that bound fail the numerical precondition. Keep smaller arithmetic excursions unchanged.
preprocessing.nilearn_equivalence_claim: this fully specified SVD-cleaning/Pearson recipe is the public task adaptation; it is not a claim that Nilearn's default covariance estimator or confound rank policy is identical

graphs.node_ids: original atlas ROI IDs 1 through100, including isolated nodes
graphs.weight_order: signed original empirical correlations, not absolute values or positive-only clipped values

proportional.rounding: nearest integer, ties to even, on density*4950; explicit k values above are authoritative
proportional.selection: include every pair with correlation >= cutoff, including every exact cutoff tie
proportional.density_disclosure: actual retained edge count divided by4950 can exceed nominal density when cutoff ties occur

absolute.selection: include every pair with unrounded correlation >= fixed cutoff
absolute.role: parallel sensitivity endpoint, not an intrinsically wrong or inferior graph

graphs.signed_edge_interpretation: a retained negative or zero correlation becomes the same binary unit-length edge as any retained positive correlation; this is not a signed weighted network analysis
graphs.paths: unweighted integer shortest-hop paths on the full symmetric 100-node adjacency
graphs.unreachable: inverse distance0; do not remove disconnected pairs or isolated nodes from the denominator
graphs.efficiency: sum_{i<j,reachable}(1/d_ij)/4950, equivalently the ordered-pair sum divided by100*99
graphs.exact_score_representation: compute counts h_d of unordered pairs at each finite integer distance d=1..99, then E=(sum_d Fraction(h_d,d))/4950; retain the resulting exact rational value for mathematical equality and ranking ties
graphs.graph_zero_cases: empty, disconnected and complete graphs are all valid; no nonzero-efficiency, nonconstant-cohort or physiological band is required
graphs.primary: unweighted arithmetic mean of the five proportional efficiencies, using exact rational arithmetic for score equality; not trapezoidal AUC

strength.mean_signed_correlation: sum of all4950 signed upper-triangle correlations divided by4950
strength.mean_positive_part_correlation: sum of max(r,0) across all4950 upper-triangle correlations divided by4950; NOT the conditional mean over positive edges
strength.role: descriptive same-participant diagnostic; a correlation sign or change is not causal confound identification

rankings_and_sensitivity.ordering: descending exact rational graph score; any order among exactly equal scores is accepted
rankings_and_sensitivity.top_set: include all people whose exact score is at least the eighth largest score, so the set may contain more than8 participants; order within the JSON top set is irrelevant
rankings_and_sensitivity.pearson: ordinary centered product-moment correlation across the40 people, not across edges or configuration rows. For exact rational graph-score or realized-density inputs, test constancy and subtract their exact rational mean before converting centered deviations to float64; do not first round scores to float64 and thereby collapse distinct exact scores
rankings_and_sensitivity.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks formed from exact rational efficiency scores; no argsort-of-argsort or ID-dependent tie ranks
rankings_and_sensitivity.constant_input: if either input vector is exactly constant, report value=null and status=undefined_constant; no near-zero epsilon or forced coefficient
rankings_and_sensitivity.diagnostic_coefficient_roundoff: for a finite computed Pearson or Spearman diagnostic coefficient, values outside[-1,1] by at most1e-12 are clamped to the nearest endpoint; a larger excursion or nonfinite coefficient fails the numerical precondition. This affects only descriptive correlation coefficients, never connectome weights, graph membership or exact score ties
rankings_and_sensitivity.density_sensitivity: report all10 unordered pairs of distinct proportional density settings, with tie-correct Spearman across40 people
rankings_and_sensitivity.rounding_policy: mathematical graph membership, cutoff ties, exact score ties and top sets are authoritative from unrounded source-derived arrays. Permitted printed rounding does not authorize changing these categories and must not create an incidental rejection when it introduces an apparent numerical tie. Correlations and summaries derive from full-precision arrays, not re-reading rounded CSV text.

outputs.findings.md: nonempty narrative; no keyword, causal claim, expected sign or ranking-change gate

table_membership.connectomes.csv: all198000 unique(participant,roi_i,roi_j) keys, i<j; every one of4950 source-label pairs for every one of40 participants
table_membership.graph_metrics.csv: all320 unique(participant,scheme,parameter) keys; scheme is proportional or absolute, numeric parameter is one of the declared five densities or three cutoffs
table_membership.efficiency.csv: all40 original participant IDs, exactly once

graph_fields.parameter: nominal density for proportional; fixed correlation cutoff for absolute
graph_fields.k_requested: declared integer for proportional, blank for absolute
graph_fields.correlation_cutoff: unrounded k-th-largest value for proportional; declared parameter for absolute
graph_fields.n_at_cutoff: number of all4950 original pair correlations exactly equal to cutoff
graph_fields.n_edges: number of pairs selected by the declared cutoff rule
graph_fields.n_negative_edges: selected pairs whose original signed correlation is <0
graph_fields.n_zero_edges: selected pairs whose original signed correlation is exactly0
graph_fields.n_components: connected components of all100 nodes, including isolated-node components
graph_fields.n_connected_pairs: unordered distinct-node pairs joined by any finite path
graph_fields.minimum_selected_correlation: minimum signed weight among selected edges; blank only when n_edges=0
graph_fields.global_efficiency: binary all-pair efficiency defined in graphs

correlation_object.value: finite number between-1 and1 for statusok; JSONnull for undefined_constant
correlation_object.n_participants: 40; do not drop people on the basis of their score or strength

output_definitions.primary_correlations: object with exactly the two named correlation diagnostics, each a correlation_object

configuration_ranking_record.ranking_by_efficiency: all 40 IDs, descending exact score, arbitrary order only within exact ties
configuration_ranking_record.top_by_efficiency: all IDs at or above this configuration's eighth-largest exact score; set order irrelevant
configuration_ranking_record.top_set_overlap_with_primary: cardinality of intersection of the two inclusive top sets; can exceed8 when boundary ties exist
configuration_ranking_record.correlations: object with the five named per-configuration diagnostics, each a correlation_object

density_pairwise_record.density_low: the smaller of two distinct declared proportional settings
density_pairwise_record.spearman: correlation_object using exact graph-score average ranks

output_definitions.source_sha256: closed object mapping every staged manifest path to its exact lowercase SHA256; not a second unverified source list

atlas.storage_dtype: original atlas NIfTI dtype name, float32 for this release; labels must nevertheless be exact integers
atlas.intensity_slope: effective original atlas scaling slope from its data proxy
atlas.intensity_intercept: effective original atlas scaling intercept from its data proxy
atlas.spatial_units: original atlas spatial unit string, mm
atlas.temporal_units: original atlas temporal unit string, sec; no atlas time-series analysis is implied
atlas.source_label_ids: complete original numeric label set including0; order irrelevant
atlas.parcels: all100 records with roi_id(integer),label(exact original LUT string),n_voxels(integer>0 on the resampled grid); record order irrelevant

participant_record.participant: exact original positive integer subject ID
participant_record.bold_path: exact original BOLD path in source manifest
participant_record.confounds_path: paired original confound path in source manifest
participant_record.tr_s: original header temporal zoom in seconds; no resampling to a common TR
participant_record.storage_dtype: original on-disk NIfTI data type, not the float64 working array type
participant_record.intensity_slope: effective finite original scaling slope from the image data proxy, after normalizing absent source scaling to its effective value; not a consumed nibabel header's None
participant_record.intensity_intercept: effective finite original scaling intercept from the image data proxy, not a consumed header's None
participant_record.spatial_units: original NIfTI spatial unit string; expected mm, never inferred solely from voxel magnitudes
participant_record.temporal_units: original NIfTI temporal unit string; expected sec, used to interpret tr_s
participant_record.n_frames: all original BOLD frames and confound rows
participant_record.n_confounds: 17 original columns before exactly constant column removal
participant_record.constant_confound_columns: original-order names identified by the exact constant rule; no outcome-dependent selection
participant_record.confound_rank: retained SVD singular-mode count under the public rank threshold
participant_record.confound_rank_threshold: computed finite nonnegative public threshold,0 only for empty confound span

output_definitions.software_versions: nonempty string-to-nonempty-string mapping reporting the actual implementation; not required to equal the oracle's libraries
output_definitions.status: ok for a complete successful40-person analysis; resource_pilot is authoring-only and never valid as a complete submission
output_definitions.undefined: CSV empty cell and JSONnull only for explicitly defined cases; do not substitute numeric0, NaN or Inf
output_definitions.identity_parsing: accept exact integral numeric notation including leading zeros, decimal and scientific notation when it preserves the integer value; reject booleans, fractions, nonfinite values and arbitrary mixed-text aliases
output_definitions.formatting: CSV row and column order, JSON record order keyed by declared IDs, and harmless extra columns/top-level descriptive fields are free. Duplicate/missing/extra scientific identities are not ignored. The source hash mapping and full public method object are closed-world; arbitrary optional analyses are not recursively keyword-scanned.

verification_tolerances.zero_source_intensity_offset: exactly0; do not apply a generic geometry absolute tolerance to intensity scaling
verification_tolerances.cutoff_and_minimum_weight: same tolerance as connectome_correlation; this tolerance does not permit altered source edge membership
verification_tolerances.realized_density: derive from exact edge count/4950; compare numeric representation within graph_efficiency_and_strength tolerance
verification_tolerances.categorical_authority: original source-driven unrounded cutoff membership and exact rational score ties, not incidental ordering of tolerated rounded participant floats
verification_tolerances.numeric_self_consistency: complete source-bound values plus recomputation from full-precision source-equivalent arrays; when serialized numeric contributors are tolerated rounded values, propagate their declared precision instead of imposing a tighter hidden arithmetic requirement
verification_tolerances.no_broad_similarity_gate: no cross-person correlation-to-reference acceptance, partial matching fraction, score dispersion minimum, physiological band or expected sensitivity direction

authoring_evidence_not_public_requiremen: all source-extracted raw parcel time series
all cleaned standardized parcel time series
source confound values, scaling and retained-span evidence
complete original/resampled atlas mapping and parcel membership
full correlation matrices and all8 adjacency matrices per participant
unordered path-length histograms and exact rational graph/primary scores
independent original-source recomputation and genuine participant-format positive

failure_handling.action: nonzero exit before publishing a successful result; no silent subject/parcel/frame drop, source substitution or numerical fallback
failure_handling.metadata: status=failed_precondition and a nonempty reason; include available checked source identity without inventing observations
failure_handling.additional_failure_artifacts: permitted, but partial products must not claim statusok

freeze_evidence: Source byte/header and atlas-geometry checks plus source-free numerical fixtures passed before any participant signal/confound-value analysis. The original participant cohort, recipe, eight configurations, tolerance values and failure rules were fixed without inspecting new scientific outcomes.
